dbqueries.dbquery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tp_messages tm, tp_messages_to tmt, tp_users tu, tp_applicants ta WHERE tm.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id AND tmt.message_to=tu.user_id AND tm.message_id = tmt.message_id AND tm.message_from =? AND tmt.message_received_type=? AND TO_DAYS(tm.message_date) >= TO_DAYS(DATE_SUB(now(),INTERVAL ? DAY) ) @@

( select ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_original_resume_path, tp.position_id, tp.position_title, tps.position_step_id, tps.position_step_title, tapp.appointment_from_date, tapp.appointment_id, (select status_message from tp_applicant_status_messages tasm where tasm.applicant_id =ta.applicant_id order by status_message_id desc limit 0,1) as status_message, ? as type from tp_applicants ta, tp_positions tp, tp_position_steps tps, tp_position_step_users tpsu, tp_appointments tapp, tp_appointment_attendees tatt where ta.applicant_position_id = tp.position_id AND ta.applicant_step_id = tps.position_step_id AND ta.applicant_step_id = tpsu.position_step_id AND tapp.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id AND ta.applicant_position_id = tapp.position_id AND ta.applicant_step_id = tapp.position_step_id AND tapp.appointment_id=tatt.appointment_id AND tps.position_step_status=? AND tp.position_status=? AND ta.applicant_joined=? AND tpsu.is_responsible_for_scheduling=? AND tpsu.user_id=? AND tatt.attendee_id=? AND tapp.appointment_status_id !=? AND tapp.appointment_from_date > now() @@ GROUP BY ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_original_resume_path, tp.position_id, tp.position_title, tps.position_step_id, tps.position_step_title, tapp.appointment_from_date, tapp.appointment_id, status_message ) @@ order by appointment_from_date desc

SELECT tp.position_id, tp.position_code, tp.position_title, tp.position_priority, tp.position_date_created, tp.position_no_of_openings, tp.position_status, tp.position_referal_fees, tp.position_level, tp.position_type_ext_int, tp.dept_name, tp.sub_dept_name, tp.sub_sub_dept_name,tp.sub4_dept_name,tp.sub3_dept_name, tp.band_name, tp.grade_name, tp.position_date_expiry, tp.position_owner_name, tp.requested_by_name, tp.recruiters, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tp.location_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS location_name, (select count(*) from tp_applicants ta ,tp_position_steps tps where ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id and ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id and tps.position_step_level=? ) as shortlistCandidates, (select count(*) from tp_applicants ta ,tp_position_steps tps where ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id and ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id and tps.position_step_level=? ) as selectCandidates, (select count(*) from tp_applicants ta ,tp_position_steps tps where ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id and ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id and tps.position_step_level=?) as offered, (select count(*) from tp_applicant_joining_history ta where ta.position_id=tp.position_id) as joined, (select count(process_id) from tp_applicant_selection_process tasp where tasp.position_step_id_to IN (?,?,?,?) and tasp.position_id = tp.position_id ) as rejected, CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(tvp.custom_field_id, '===', IFNULL(tvp.string_value, IFNULL(tvp.number_value, tvp.date_value)) SEPARATOR '$$$') AS CHAR) AS custom_fields FROM ( SELECT tp.position_id, tp.position_code, tp.position_title, tp.position_priority, tp.position_date_created, tp.position_no_of_openings, tp.position_status, tp.position_referal_fees, tp.position_level, tp.position_type_ext_int, td.dept_name as dept_name, tds.dept_name as sub_dept_name, tdss.dept_name as sub_sub_dept_name, tds3.dept_name as sub3_dept_name,tds4.dept_name as sub4_dept_name, tb.band_name, tg.grade_name, tl.location_name, tp.position_date_expiry, CONCAT(tupo.user_fname, ' ', tupo.user_lname) AS position_owner_name, CONCAT(tu1.user_fname, ' ', tu1.user_lname) AS requested_by_name, (select recruiters from (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT recruiters) as recruiters , position_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(tu.user_fname, ' ', tu.user_lname) as recruiters , tpi.position_id FROM tp_positions tpi left join tp_position_step_users tpsu on (tpsu.position_id = tpi.position_id and tpi.position_status='1') left join tp_user_roles tur on (tur.user_id = tpsu.user_id and tur.role_id=?) left join tp_users tu on (tu.user_id = tur.user_id) left join tp_position_steps tps on (tps.position_step_id = tpsu.position_step_id and tps.position_step_status=?)
UNION SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(tu.user_fname, ' ', tu.user_lname) as recruiters , tpi.position_id FROM tp_positions tpi
left join tp_users tu on(tu.user_id = tpi.position_requested_by and tpi.position_status = '1') left join tp_user_roles tur on (tur.user_id = tu.user_id and tur.role_id =?) ) A group by position_id ) AMain where AMain.position_id = tp.position_id) AS recruiters FROM tp_positions tp LEFT JOIN tp_departments td ON (tp.dept_id=td.dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tds ON (tp.sub_dept_id=tds.dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tdss ON (tp.sub_sub_dept_id=tdss.dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tds3 ON (tp.sub3_dept_id=tds3.dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_departments tds4 ON (tp.sub4_dept_id=tds4.dept_id) LEFT JOIN tp_users tu1 ON (tp.position_requested_by=tu1.user_id) LEFT JOIN tp_users tupo ON (tp.position_owner_id=tupo.user_id) LEFT JOIN tp_budget_grades tg ON (tp.grade_id=tg.grade_id) LEFT JOIN tp_budget_bands tb ON (tp.band_id=tb.band_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_locations tpl ON (tpl.position_id = tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_location_ap tl ON (tpl.location_id = tl.location_id) WHERE tp.position_status=? @@ @@ )AS tp LEFT JOIN tp_custom_field_values_position tvp ON (tvp.entity_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_custom_fields tcfp ON (tcfp.custom_field_id=tvp.custom_field_id) GROUP BY tp.position_id order by tp.position_priority desc,tp.position_title

select dept_name,CAST(group_concat(distinct dept_id) AS CHAR) as dept_id, position_requested_by,requested_by_name,position_type_ext_int, CASE WHEN position_owner_id IS NULL THEN ? ELSE position_owner_id END AS position_owner_id, CASE WHEN position_owner_id IS NULL THEN ? ELSE position_owner_name END AS position_owner_name, count(position_id) as count, SUM(position_no_of_openings) as position_no_of_openings, SUM(shortlistCandidates) as shortlistCandidates, SUM(selectCandidates) as selectCandidates, SUM(offered) as offered, SUM(joined) as joined, SUM(rejected) as rejected from ( SELECT tp.position_id,tp.position_priority,tp.position_type_ext_int, tp.position_requested_by, CONCAT(tu1.user_fname, ' ', tu1.user_lname) AS requested_by_name, tp.position_owner_id, CONCAT(tupo.user_fname, ' ', tupo.user_lname) AS position_owner_name, tp.position_no_of_openings, (select count(*) from tp_applicants ta ,tp_position_steps tps where ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id and ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id and tps.position_step_level=? ) as shortlistCandidates, (select count(*) from tp_applicants ta ,tp_position_steps tps where ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id and ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id and tps.position_step_level=? ) as selectCandidates, (select count(*) from tp_applicants ta ,tp_position_steps tps where ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id and ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id and tps.position_step_level=?) as offered, (select count(*) from tp_applicant_joining_history ta where ta.position_id=tp.position_id) as joined, (SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT * FROM tp_applicant_selection_process WHERE position_step_id_to IN (?,?,?,?) ) AS tasp WHERE tasp.position_id=tp.position_id )AS rejected, td.dept_name,td.dept_id from tp_positions tp LEFT JOIN tp_users tupo ON (tp.position_owner_id = tupo.user_id), tp_departments td, tp_users tu1 where tp.@@=td.dept_id and tp.position_requested_by=tu1.user_id and tp.position_status=? @@ ) as position_summary @@ @@

select location_name,location_id, count(position_id) as count, SUM(position_no_of_openings) as position_no_of_openings, SUM(shortlistCandidates) as shortlistCandidates, SUM(selectCandidates) as selectCandidates, SUM(offered) as offered, SUM(joined) as joined, SUM(rejected) as rejected from ( SELECT tp.position_id,tp.position_priority,tpl.location_id,tl.location_name, tp.position_no_of_openings, (select count(*) from tp_applicants ta ,tp_position_steps tps where ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id and ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id and tps.position_step_level=? ) as shortlistCandidates, (select count(*) from tp_applicants ta ,tp_position_steps tps where ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id and ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id and tps.position_step_level=? ) as selectCandidates, (select count(*) from tp_applicants ta ,tp_position_steps tps where ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id and ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id and tps.position_step_level=?) as offered, (select count(*) from tp_applicant_joining_history ta where ta.position_id=tp.position_id) as joined, (SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT * FROM tp_applicant_selection_process WHERE position_step_id_to IN (?,?,?,?) ) AS tasp WHERE tasp.position_id=tp.position_id )AS rejected from tp_positions tp,tp_position_locations tpl,tp_location_ap tl where tp.position_status=? AND tpl.position_id = tp.position_id AND tpl.location_id=tl.location_id @@ ) as position_summary group by location_name order by location_name

SELECT tm.message_id, tm.applicant_id, tm.message_text, tm.message_date, tu.user_id as messageFromId, CONCAT(tu.user_fname,' ',tu.user_lname) as messageFrom, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_original_resume_path, tmt.message_to FROM tp_messages tm, tp_messages_to tmt, tp_users tu, tp_applicants ta WHERE tm.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id AND tm.message_from=tu.user_id AND tm.message_id = tmt.message_id AND tmt.message_to =? AND tmt.message_read = ? @@ ORDER BY message_date desc

SELECT tm.message_id, tm.applicant_id, tm.message_text, tm.message_date, CONCAT(tu.user_fname,' ',tu.user_lname) as messageTo, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_original_resume_path FROM tp_messages tm, tp_messages_to tmt, tp_users tu, tp_applicants ta WHERE tm.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id AND tmt.message_to=tu.user_id AND tm.message_id = tmt.message_id AND tm.message_from =? AND tmt.message_received_type=? AND TO_DAYS(tm.message_date) >= TO_DAYS(DATE_SUB(now(),INTERVAL ? DAY) ) @@ ORDER BY message_date desc
UPDATE tp_messages_to SET message_read =? WHERE message_id in(@@) AND message_to=?

SELECT trem.reminder_id, trem.applicant_id, trem.reminder_date, trem.reminder_desc, ta.applicant_name FROM tp_reminder trem LEFT JOIN tp_applicants ta ON(trem.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id) WHERE trem.user_id=? ORDER BY trem.reminder_date

SELECT *, @@ FROM ( SELECT applicant_id, applicant_name, position_id, position_code, position_title, step_name, due_date, current_step_id, todo_type, action_type, null as email_id, todo.flag_id FROM ( SELECT *, count(*) AS number, CONVERT(sum(feedback_present), SIGNED) AS feedback FROM ( SELECT todo.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, todo.position_id, tpos.position_code, tpos.position_title, tps.position_step_title AS step_name, todo.due_date AS due_date, todo.current_step_id, todo.todo_type, todo.feedback_present,
CASE WHEN tps.position_step_isscheduled =? THEN CASE WHEN todo.appointment_time is null THEN ? ELSE CASE WHEN todo.appointment_time < now() THEN CASE WHEN (todo.appointment_status_id !=? AND todo.appointment_status_id !=?) THEN ? ELSE ? END ELSE ? END END ELSE ? END AS action_type,
CASE WHEN todo.step_isscheduled=? THEN CASE WHEN todo.appointment_time IS NULL THEN IF(todo.user_responsible_for_scheduling=?,1,0) ELSE CASE WHEN todo.appointment_time < now() THEN CASE WHEN (todo.appointment_status_id !=? AND todo.appointment_status_id !=?) THEN CASE WHEN todo.interviewer_can_confirm=? THEN IF(todo.user_is_interviewer=? OR todo.user_responsible_for_scheduling=?,1,0) ELSE IF(todo.user_responsible_for_scheduling=?,1,0) END ELSE IF(todo.user_is_interviewer=? OR todo.user_is_decision_maker=?,1,0) END ELSE IF(todo.user_is_interviewer=?,1,0) END END ELSE 1 END AS todoUser, taf.flag_id
FROM tp_todo todo ,tp_positions tpos ,tp_users tu, tp_position_steps tps, tp_applicants ta LEFT JOIN tp_applicant_flags taf ON (ta.applicant_id=taf.applicant_id) WHERE todo.position_id=tpos.position_id AND todo.current_step_id = tps.position_step_id AND todo.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id AND todo.user_id=tu.user_id AND todo.todo_type=? AND tpos.position_status = ? AND todo.user_id=? @@ ) AS todo WHERE todoUser=1 AND action_type!=? GROUP BY todo.applicant_id, todo.position_id
) AS todo WHERE todo.number != todo.feedback
UNION ALL
SELECT null,null, todo.position_id,tpos.position_code, tpos.position_title, tras.requisition_approval_step_name AS step_name , todo.due_date AS due_date, todo.current_step_id, todo.todo_type, ? as action_type, null as email_id, null FROM tp_todo todo ,tp_positions tpos, tp_requisition_approval_steps tras WHERE todo.position_id=tpos.position_id AND todo.current_step_id= tras.requisition_approval_step_id AND todo.todo_type=? AND todo.user_id=?
UNION ALL
SELECT null,null, null,null, null, tbi.budget_item_name AS step_name , todo.due_date AS due_date, tbi.budget_item_id, todo.todo_type, ? as action_type, null as email_id, null FROM tp_todo todo ,tp_budget_items tbi WHERE todo.budget_item_id=tbi.budget_item_id AND todo.todo_type=? AND todo.user_id=?
UNION ALL
SELECT tpa.applicant_id, tpa.applicant_name, tpp.position_id, tpp.position_code, tpp.position_title, tpps.position_step_title AS step_name, '' , tpps.position_step_id, ? AS todo_type, ? as action_type, tie.email_id, null FROM tp_inbox_emails tie LEFT JOIN tp_applicants tpa ON (tpa.applicant_id = tie.applicant_id) LEFT JOIN tp_positions tpp ON (tpp.position_id = tie.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_steps tpps ON (tpps.position_step_id = tie.position_step_id) WHERE tie.folder_id = (SELECT folder_id FROM tp_inbox_folders WHERE is_system_defined = ? ) @@
) AS action @@ @@ @@ limit 500
